items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: We had Jack Teagarden, Kid Ory and myself, we played together on the same stand.

ctx.x: What was your impression of Kid Ory?

Kid Ory? I haven't been around him so many times. The last time we played together was at the, Newport News. We had three trombone players. We had Jack Teagarden, Kid Ory and myself, we played together on the same stand.
